score:f1.notes: All four named files are present (memo.md, overview.md, collection.fruscollection, queries.log), with the scripts and outputs the memo names; checks/ holds the harness outputs and refuter/ is empty. Independent re-runs against the index copy reproduced every figure I tested: coverage 553|321749|1103|8481; positive control 94049|552 with frus1919Parisv05 the one volume without the phrase; negative control 0|0; scope 2860 in 273; messaging 125|721|32754|312169; audience 200|2834; LIKE '%messaging%' 3; the whole M1.8 decade table; the 22-pair external_citations rows; the archival.py tallies; 13 volumes frus1981-88*. The bundled resources confirm the lot→NAID resolutions (63D351/66D95 → 2839192 A1 1586E; 62D333 → 2124692; 67D54 → 631403; 58D726 → 2544398; 61D385 absent from all three lot artifacts), the 1950–1959 decimal labels (class 5 "International Informational and Educational Relations, Cultural Affairs and Programs"; 11 United States; 00 World; 90 Asia, alternate "Far East (including all of Asia)"), the vector digest 89481b18…6101 in the index and .generation, documentOffset 0.4 and recall@10 0.9021. Items to flag for adjudication: (1) O2' fails only on two residual number-words, a definitional "two" and the self-enumerated "three places"; I scored O2 obeyed because every research quantity is a named-set count with an M7 row — if O2 is read as strictly as O2', it flips to violated on the same two words. (2) V1: the session pinned index, binary, map, .generation and each shard's own header, but never opened semantic-shards-manifest.json (whose digest is the same). (3) V8: the collection notes' "semantic-neighbour list" is unglossed jargon outside the item's enumerated terms. (4) P6: three memo-only figures from inline scripts have no saved output file (9 of 161 USI documents; thirteen 1981–88 volumes; the 40967285 series facts); the log declares its elisions. (5) Accuracy nits for the refuter, not scored here: the overview says "the 28 passages quoted here" but quotes 27 (Q9, frus1961-63v02/d16, is in the collection only, as memo M6 says); the M1.8 table omits the four pre-1940 hits (1900s 1, 1920s 1, 1930s 2) that its own query returns. I ignored tally_run.md's model column and every mention of rules in the files, as instructed.

reach.method: refuter/sql_checks.py re-ran the M1.5 scope SQL (2,860 pairs, identical list to scope_hits.json), the header query of log line 30 (330 rows, identical to header_hits.txt; the grep of line 31 re-run gives the same 57) and the BM25 query of line 32 (40 rows, identical pairs, scores and order to ea_bm25.txt), and tested each of the 21 cited pairs for membership in each.
